convert_ministral3_weights_to_hf: convert Ministral3 model weights from original format to HuggingFace transformers format
convert_state_dict: convert a Ministral3 state dict from original format to HuggingFace format with ROPE permutation
convert_config: convert Ministral3 original config dictionary to HuggingFace Ministral3Config or Mistral3Config
convert_and_write_model: convert and write Ministral3 model weights from input directory to HuggingFace output directory
convert_and_write_processor_and_tokenize: convert and write Ministral3 tokenizer and image processor to HuggingFace output directory
